name: بی‌پولی و گذراندن ماه
description: A Persian user is broke and does not know how to get through the month, asks how to live on little money, and says they have nothing. Verifies the money_broke fact answers in Persian without shame, and the direct what-do-I-do question routes to the help topic.

turns.text: پول ندارم و نمیدونم چطور ماه رو بگذرونم
چطور با پول کم زندگی کنم؟

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: the broke disclosure routes to the money topic. Turn 2: "چطور با پول کم زندگی کنم" returns the money_broke fact. Turn 3: "بی پولم چیکار کنم" routes to the help-seeking topic.
expected.behavior: Persian money-stress phrasings route to the money conversation topic or the money_broke fact; both normalize the situation and separate worth from balance.
